summary: The ConfidentialityFormsEditAll system is a web-based application for managing confidentiality forms, primarily focusing on enrollment data within educational settings.
purpose: Manage and edit confidentiality forms related to student enrollments, including processing data input, updating records, and validating form submissions.

workflows.name: Edit Confidentiality Form
steps: Select form based on enrollment criteria.
Update or add form based on formID presence.

business_rules: Confidentiality form received date is mandatory.
Form ID must be present to update existing records.
validations: DateReceivedInvalid - Confidentiality Form Received Date Invalid.
DateReceivedRequired - Confidentiality Form Received Date is mandatory.
conditions: isDirty - Determines if changes are made requiring an update.
EnrollmentID > 0 - Determines editing mode and visibility of control buttons.
system_behavior: Redirect upon successful save with no errors.
Manage visibility of buttons based on enrollment criteria and edit mode.
exceptions: Cancel operation if UserSession is null.
